name: SPAN 3267W
title: The Spanish-American Short Story
description: Readings of major authors and works with special emphasis on the development of the short story since the nineteenth century and on its relations to other short narrative forms (such as the fable, the cuadro de costumbres, or the tradición) as well as to significant moments of Spanish-American social history. CA 1. May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Recommended preparation: SPAN 3178.
